notes.title: ver 7.00 release
notes.notes:
Fixed

 Fixed some crashing bugs.
 Revised OP talk event.
 Optimization.
 Fixed that the end of the movie in some events is strange.
 Fixed a bug that the weapon acquisition info remains displayed.
 Fixed a bug that the SFX did not sound in the loading scene.

notes.title: ver 6.07 release
notes.notes:
Fixed

 Settings screen：Fixed the bug that AIMX / AIMY items can not be selected by key assignment.
 StationSelect screen: asakusa, roppongi station images replace to correct one.
 Fixed a bug that caused the player to turn to the left when aiming up and down when aim mode is "not using aim".
 Fixed a bug that caused damage to 1 in some attack actions of the last boss.
 Fixed a bug that blackout occurs in talk event after ending.
 Correct achievement name of Chinese.

notes.title: ver 6.05 release
notes.notes:
*v6.05.3: fixed chinese font


Fixed

 Fixed a bug that freezes when talking to Fow in base train.
 Akihabara stage:Fixed bug that rock is not destroyed by the drill and can not advance.
 Roppongi stage: Fixed a bug that maps would not load and fall when moving from a checkpoint to the ground.
 Roppongi stage: Fixed a bug that all souvenirs were acquired but achievement could not be acquired.
 Roppongi stage: Fixed a bug that skillpoint acquisition is not displayed after talking to Fow.
 Roppongi stage:Fixed the bug that the enemy name "blood vessel" is displayed as "Unknown Id".
 Fixed a bug that some joystick keys can not be assigned keys

notes.title: ver 4.06 release
notes.notes:
Fixed
· Transition confirmation message of "Virtual Combat simulator" does not disappear
· Fixed a bug in Budokan boss
· Fixed a bug that BESTTIME will not be updated after boss rematch
· Fixed the behavior of Ichigaya Boss
· Fixed bug in shop list item notation
· Fixed a bug that area transition is not working
· Other minor fixes

notes.title: ver 4.02 release
notes.notes:
Fixed
· Fixed that when the skill level is all allocated, that message does not displayed at the start of battle.
· The robot that rescued on the Shinjuku ground was not displayed at train
· 'Nagadosu' obtained on the Shinjuku ground is not displayed at train
· Weapons "Nagadosu" can not be obtained
· Sinjuku groud souvenir achievement
· Gallery 'Attack' can not be played
· Gallery 'Silver haired girl' can not be played
· Gallery 'The heartbeat of the Oblivion' can not be played
· Fixed that disappearable floor.
· Fixed some problems in Chinese text
· Fixed a bug that the 'Rapid Fire' achievement targeted sword equipment only.
· Fixed a bug that the 'Destroyer' achievement targeted sword equipment only.
· Other minor fixes

* If the skill point is negative, it will be reset on loading.
* Save data that has ended the Yakuza event gets "Nagadosu" at the time of loading.
